info.name: Network Route Optimizer API
info.description:
Ready-to-run demo for the Network Route Optimizer API.

**Setup:** start the API (`make up` or `make run`) and import this file - nothing else is needed. Two collection variables are preset, so there is nothing to configure when the API runs locally:

| Variable | Default | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | `http://localhost:8000/api/v1` | all `/nodes`, `/edges`, `/routes` requests |
| `health_url` | `http://localhost:8000/health` | the health check (it lives outside `/api/v1`) |

To point at another host, edit both in the collection's *Variables* tab (change the host and port, keep the paths). The API is open: no authentication, as per the contract.

**How to use:** click *Run* on the collection (Collection Runner) to execute everything top to bottom, or send requests one by one - folders are ordered so state flows downwards (create nodes before edges, edges before routes). Every request carries assertions.

**Warning:** folder *1 - Reset demo data* deletes ALL nodes (and their edges). Use it on a demo database only.

**Demo graph:**
```
A --12.5--> B --10.9--> D   (A->D = 23.4 via B)
A --5.0---> C --30.0--> D   (35.0 via C)
```
